thread:
incident-bot: Paging on-call: HIGH severity — model-rollout spike on prod (route: /v1/generate). Incident ID INC-20260529-1. Root TS 1714501234 :rotating_light:

maria.ops: acknowledged — I’m on it. joining bridge now. setting priority: customer-facing latency + 5xx increase.

jonathan.eng: on-call, hopping on the bridge. any quick numbers?

maria.ops: telemetry: p95 latency jumped ~3x for default route, 5xx rate up from 0.4% -> ~6.8% in last 6m. spikes correlate with model rollout to v2.3.1 canary at 09:12 UTC. dashboards: https://dash.redwood.local/ops/INC-20260529-1

incident-bot: Alert summary: alert_id=ALRT-9876; metric=error_rate; threshold=5%; fired_at=1714501200; hosts_impacted=12; affected_tenant=multiple.

jonathan.eng: can we confirm canary variants? who rolled v2.3.1?

maria.ops: rollout triggered by alice.prod at 09:11 UTC via CI. Canary set = 5% traffic; but looks like routing drifted to ~40% for a small subset of regions.

alice.prod: yep, I kicked the rollout. No manual changes after deploy. I see the canary policy was `canary: 5% -> 25% after 10m` — maybe autoscaling policy bumped traffic?

devex-liaison: pinging infra — autoscaler might have rebalanced shards across AZs, could have impacted routing tables.

jonathan.eng: grabbing logs from model pods. attaching recent error tail:

```
2026-05-29T09:13:02Z ERROR model-runner: kvcache evict failed: mismatch seq=2908 expected=2896
2026-05-29T09:13:02Z WARN  runtime: short-circuit fallback to CPU for shard gpu-7
2026-05-29T09:13:03Z ERROR api: handler.go:112 500 "model run failed: quantize mismatch: q8->q4 conversion failed" trace_id=trc_0a4b
```

maria.ops: interesting — two things: (1) kvcache mismatch + evictions, (2) quantize mismatch errors. both started right after v2.3.1 image.

tim.models: adding context — v2.3.1 includes a new quantization profile that reduces model params memory by ~25% but uses a modified serialization format. Should be backward-compatible but we did change serializer version.

jonathan.eng: hypothesis list (short):
1) serializer/quantization format incompat w/ runtime -> q-errors -> 5xx
2) kv-cache format change causing state mismatch on warm starts -> fallback thrashing -> latency 
3) routing/autoscaler inadvertently shifted traffic to non-canary pool (config drift)

maria.ops: can we reproduce on staging? timeline: deploy started 09:11, first errors 09:13, alert at 09:14, spike ongoing.

alice.prod: I’ll pause the rollout in the console now.

incident-bot: Rollout pause command executed by alice.prod at 1714501285. status=PAUSED :white_check_mark:

jonathan.eng: good. next decision: rollback the canary to v2.3.0 for default route, or pin affected tenants? tradeoffs: rollback gives quick mitigation; pinning reduces blast but needs per-tenant ops.

maria.ops: customer impact: several enterprise tenants see degraded ingest & higher tail latency — support tickets coming in. I recommend rollback to restore SLA ASAP.

tim.models: Agree rollback. v2.3.0 was stable. I’ll prepare the model artifact checks.

jonathan.eng: executing emergency rollback now: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --route default --model mymodel@v2.3.0 --force --reason "INC-20260529-1 emergency"`

incident-bot: Command received (jonathan.eng). Starting rollback job rb-20260529-42.

jonathan.eng: rollback started. monitoring deploy logs:

```
[09:20:12] rolling back traffic: 40% -> 20% -> 0% to v2.3.1
[09:20:45] deploying v2.3.0 to pool-12
[09:21:03] healthcheck: pod-ml-45 OK
[09:22:17] route default now serving v2.3.0
```

maria.ops: error rate dropping — current 5xx ~0.6%; p95 latency back to ~210ms. Looks like rollback helped.

alice.prod: confirming: canary paused and rollback complete. I’ll open a post-action ticket to block v2.3.1 until RCA.

devex-liaison: recording timeline for RCA doc:
- 09:11 deploy v2.3.1 canary (alice.prod)
- 09:12 autoscaler/traffic rebalance -> canary traffic drifted
- 09:13 first 5xx + kvcache warnings
- 09:14 alert fired ALRT-9876
- 09:18 decision to pause rollout
- 09:20 rollback started (jonathan.eng)
- 09:22 rollback completed, metrics improving

jonathan.eng: attaching canary diffs we saw pre-rollback:

```
metric,p95_ms,p99_ms,error_rate
v2.3.0,180,320,0.4
v2.3.1,650,980,6.8
```

maria.ops: note: error samples show repeated `quantize mismatch` and `kvcache evict failed`. trace_ids: trc_0a4b, trc_0a4c, trc_0a4d attached in thread.

tim.models: immediate follow-ups (owners):
- models: tim.models -> validate serializer versioning, write backward compatibility tests
- runtime: jonathan.eng -> add defensive checks for quantize mismatches and fail-fast earlier
- infra: devex-liaison -> investigate autoscaler behavior and routing drift
- product: alice.prod -> pause releases until signoff + add rollout guard rails

alice.prod: assigning follow-up ticket INC-20260529-1-RCA and linking to repo: https://git.redwood.local/infra/rollouts/issues/INC-20260529-1

maria.ops: on-call handoff: I’ll be handing to jonathan.eng for the postmortem write-up. jonathan, take it?

jonathan.eng: taking postmortem. I’ll assemble logs + canary diffs + timeline. Target doc by EOD. Also will collect the following artifacts:
- pod logs for pods gpu-7/gpu-9 (09:10-09:25)
- `redwoodctl rollout history --route default --since 09:00` output
- perf traces for trace_ids above

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260529-1 status: MITIGATED. responders: maria.ops, jonathan.eng, alice.prod, tim.models. mitigation_summary: rolled back to v2.3.0.

maria.ops: final quick notes for RCA thread: do not re-run v2.3.1 in prod until serializer compatibility fixed + autoscaler guard added. tagging follow-ups and scheduling postmortem review tomorrow 10:00 UTC. :calendar:
